mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_name, area_id, shop_kind_id, is_closed FROM shops WHERE shop_name = #{shopName} AND area_id = #{areaId} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shops (shop_name, area_id, shop_kind_id) VALUES (#{shopName}, #{areaId}, #{shopKindId})
mapper.select:
SELECT id, shop_name, area_id, shop_kind_id, is_closed FROM shops WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND is_closed = FALSE
AND ( shop_name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%')
OR LOWER(shop_name COLLATE utf8mb4_ja_0900_as_cs) = LOWER(#{sameKeyword})
)
ORDER BY
shop_name = #{sameKeyword} DESC, LOWER(shop_name COLLATE utf8mb4_ja_0900_as_cs) = LOWER(#{sameKeyword}) DESC,
shop_name LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, shop_name, area_id, shop_kind_id, is_closed FROM shops WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND is_closed = FALSE ORDER BY shop_name, id

SELECT shops.id, shops.shop_name, shops.area_id, shops.shop_kind_id, shops.is_closed FROM shops LEFT JOIN ( SELECT items.shop_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count, MAX(records.eaten_on) AS last_eaten_on FROM records JOIN items ON items.id = records.item_id WHERE records.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY items.shop_id ) AS my_shop_records ON my_shop_records.shop_id = shops.id WHERE shops.area_id = #{areaId} AND shops.is_closed = FALSE ORDER BY COALESCE(my_shop_records.record_count, 0) DESC, my_shop_records.last_eaten_on DESC, shops.shop_name, shops.id LIMIT #{limit}
